text:
[Council File 26-1354]
Motion (Hernandez – Jurado) relative to amending the Los Angeles Administrative Code revising the advisory duties assigned to the Board of Transportation Commissioners in connection with Exclusive Negotiation Agreements and Disposition and Development Agreements.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Amending the Los Angeles Administrative Code to revise the advisory duties of the Board of Transportation Commissioners regarding land development agreements.

outcome.text: Transportation Committee approved item(s) (Oct 7, 2026); Council adopted item as amended by Amending Motion 7A (Hernandez - Rodriguez), subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Oct 16, 2026)
